Draft/Notes:

Slide 1 — Welcome & Objectives
- Introductions: attendees, roles, primary contacts
- Onboarding purpose and expected outcomes
- Session agenda and overall onboarding timeline

Slide 2 — Company & Team
- Brief company value proposition and mission
- Customer success and implementation team roles
- Primary contacts, escalation path, and partner ecosystem

Slide 3 — Product Overview & Key Capabilities
- Core features mapped to your top objectives
- Planned demo/walkthrough focus areas
- Security, compliance, and platform compatibility summary

Slide 4 — Implementation Plan & Timeline
- Phased onboarding plan with milestones and deliverables
- Responsibilities: what we deliver vs customer actions
- Estimated schedule, dependencies, and go-live criteria

Slide 5 — Training, Support & Resources
- Training options: live sessions, workshops, and self-serve materials
- Support channels, SLA expectations, and escalation process
- Available resources: knowledge base, templates, playbooks

Slide 6 — Success Metrics & Next Steps
- Key performance indicators, measurement, and reporting cadence
- Immediate next steps, owners, and short-term timeline
- Feedback process and timing for the first review/check-in
